text:
The sea is nothing but a well of dark water,

the stars are only shining mud,

love, dream, glands, madness,

the night is not blue, it is yellow.


The stars are only shining mud,

the sea is nothing but a well of bitter water,

the night is not blue, it is yellow,

the night is not deep, it is cold and long.


The sea is nothing but a well of bitter water,

despite the verses men have written,

the sea is nothing but a well of dark water.


The night is not deep, it is cold and long;

despite the verses men have written,

love, dream, glands, madness.

translation.title: The Sea Is Nothing but a Well
